{{gdis|Mirage Island|III}} }} '''It All Ends Now V''' (Japanese: '''最終超決戦V''' ''The Final Battle V''), titled '''The Final Showdown V''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 264th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 84th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''Crime and Punishment''' (Japanese: '''罪と罰''' ''Crime and Punishment'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Crime and Punishment''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} have left to continue their eternal slumber. However, while Kyogre went back to the [[Seafloor Cavern]], Groudon has chosen to make [[Mt. Chimney]] its new resting place. At the [[Pokémon Association]] headquarters, [[Captain Stern]] and the Pokémon Association Chairman confirm that since the two Pokémon have left, it means that they no longer intend to battle each other. Although slightly irritated that he had to have {{adv|Norman}} help defeat Groudon and Kyogre with {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}, the Chairman thanks the [[Gym Leader]]s, [[Hoenn]] [[Elite Four]], as well as {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} for their contributions. The Chairman decides to inform the entire Hoenn region of the good news. [[Wallace]] calls and reveals that {{Steven}} had fallen in the battle. The Chairman tells Wallace to take Steven to the hospital, but Wallace states that it's too late because Steven has died. Wallace guesses that the strain of controlling {{p|Regirock}}, {{p|Regice}}, and {{p|Registeel}} was too much for Steven, causing his death. [[Phoebe]] notes that on the slab, it was written that the three Pokémon were sealed away by people out of fear for them. [[Sidney]] and [[Drake]] assume that the reason they were sealed was due to the danger of controlling them, and that if not controlled properly, they could become a threat like Groudon and Kyogre. [[Glacia]] notices that after Steven died, the team used to summon Regirock, Regice, and Registeel had fallen apart. Immediately, Regirock, Regice, and Registeel knock the Elite Four and Wallace off of them and fly off into parts unknown. Back in [[Sootopolis City]], Ruby tries to get a response from his father, Norman, but to no avail. Rayquaza flies past them, knocking Ruby and Norman to the ground. Norman begins to speak, and states that since Rayquaza is an ancient Pokémon like Groudon and Kyogre, it's impossible for it to be fully controlled. Norman reveals that Groudon and Kyogre can only be controlled because of the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s, but since no such Orb exists for Rayquaza, it can't be controlled like the other two. Norman states that the Pokémon Association had been researching Rayquaza ever since they captured it, even trying to create a [[Jade Orb|Green Orb]] for it, but failed. Norman tells Ruby that Rayquaza escaped on the day of his Gym Leader inauguration test, which is why he was forced to wait five years before he could take it again. In his head, Ruby realizes that the reason why he couldn't take the test was because of a punishment, and questions why he would have to be punished for Rayquaza escaping. Ruby wonders why a person like his father would have to be punished for something like that, which makes him realize that he must have taken the blame off of someone else. Ruby asks Norman if the person he took the blame of was him, a question Norman confirms as yes. Norman flashes back to five years ago, where, in the [[Johto]] region, [[Mom (Hoenn)|Ruby's mother]] celebrates with Norman over his upcoming Gym Leader inauguration test. [[Professor Birch]] jokingly points out that anything can happen during the test. They wonder where the children are, only to see the two of them playing together. When Norman decides to go the area where he will take the test early, the research tower near them begins shaking. Immediately, Rayquaza flies out of the tower and begins attacking. Norman manages to fend off Rayquaza's attacks, but it escapes and flies off. Norman and Birch go inside the research tower and find an unconscious {{p|Salamence}} inside. They find an injured scientist, who reveals that the Salamence suddenly burst into the tower and began destroying everything. Norman notices that the Salamence is injured, but the scientist states that it was injured when it burst into the tower. Upon checking the Salamence's wounds, Norman quickly realizes that the person who defeated it was Ruby. Due to Ruby being unlike most children, who would run from something like a Salamence, Ruby would stay and fight. Despite Ruby managing to defeat it, he didn't capture or prevent it from escaping, which allowed it to roam free and go on a rampage. At the Gym Leader test hall, the Pokémon Association Chairman and [[Wattson]] impatiently wait for Norman to arrive. Suddenly, someone bursts into the room to inform them about what happened at the research tower. When the director asks who set Rayquaza free, Norman steps in and lies by stating that it was him who did it. A few days later, the Pokémon Association tells Norman that he is banned from taking the test for five years. They tell Norman that his punishment is to find and recapture Rayquaza, which Norman begrudgingly accepts. When Norman asks why the Association was researching Rayquaza, the Chairman tells him that it's none of his business, fueling their contempt of each other. Later, Norman tells his sad family that he has to leave, but doesn't tell them why. As Norman prepares to leave, Ruby tries to get his father to take him with. Norman tells Ruby that he can't, and that he must continue his training without his father to guide him. Although Ruby continues to try and get his father to take him with, Norman has his {{TP|Norman|Slaking}} restrain Ruby as he takes off. Riding on his {{p|Flygon}}, Norman searches for Rayquaza and approaches a small island. Back in the present, Ruby asks Norman why he sacrificed everything just to protect him. Norman doesn't speak, but Ruby realizes after seeing [[Courtney]]'s Memory Lighter that Norman did it because he loves him. Norman collapses, leading to Ruby shouting out his name his horror. Suddenly, an explosion bursts forth from the [[Cave of Origin]]'s ruins. Back on {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}}, [[Tate and Liza]] express joy over Ruby and Sapphire's victory. They note that [[Juan]] had a prediction of both of them fighting two powerful foes, but since Ruby stopped Groudon and Kyogre alone, it didn't come true. Juan agrees with this, but wonders if the foes he thought of were not Groudon and Kyogre. Back at Wallace's aircar, {{TP|Ruby|Plusle}} and {{TP|Sapphire|Minun}} begin shooting electricity everywhere, much to Sapphire's confusion. Sapphire quickly realizes that they must sense something happening in Sootopolis City. Back at Ruby's location, [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]] have appeared before him and prepare to attack. Ruby realizes that after he and Sapphire knocked the Red and Blue Orbs out of their bodies, they went to hide in the Cave of Origin. Maxie and Archie attack Ruby, and state that anyone who will stand in their way will die. ==Major events== * {{Steven}} dies from exhaustion. * {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} leave to sleep once more. * {{TP|Brandon|Regirock, Regice, Registeel|legendary giants}}, and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}} leave. * {{adv|Ruby}} learns that he was the reason why {{adv|Norman}} had to wait to take his [[Gym Leader]] test again. * Norman dies. * [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]] reappear to take revenge on Ruby. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * {{adv|Norman}} * [[Professor Birch]] (flashback) * [[Roxanne]] (fantasy) * [[Brawly]] (fantasy) * [[Wattson]] (flashback) * [[Flannery]] (fantasy) * [[Winona]] (fantasy) * [[Tate and Liza]] * [[Juan]] * [[Sidney]] * [[Phoebe]] * [[Glacia]] * [[Drake]] * [[Wallace]] * [[Steven Stone]] * [[Archie]] * [[Maxie]] * [[Courtney]]/{{tt|Marge|Chuang Yi}} (flashback) * [[Captain Stern]] * {{prof|Yanase Berlitz}} (flashback) * [[Mom (Hoenn)|Ruby's mother]] (flashback) * [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Poochyena}} ([[Nana]];
